div.div:
Reading this diagram
There is exactly one consumer today, P5, so every other arrow into a store is a write. The four ingestion processes never read back what they wrote, and their Kafka policies deny it.
D7 is the honest gap: the store exists, the writer exists, and what it writes goes to a log line rather than to object storage with a signed manifest.
